systems.system: e-ID Togo biometric enrolment and card issue
systems.owner: Agence Nationale d'Identification (ANID), under the WURI project
systems.tiers: ANID's own enrolment centres, in schools and other sites across the six communes of Agoe-Nyive; in Golfe prefecture card pickup at the mairies where enrolment centres sit, to October 2025

note: ANID communique of 8 September 2025: the national agency's own enrolment centres, some hosted at mairies in Golfe prefecture. It does not say the mairies' offices or staff are connected or work in the system.
